Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys again!

Please assure me that with The Summoning i can play an ally i've just played with the same minion!

For example: Una plays Shadow Court Satyr - untaps via Freak Drive - plays a Summoning to "summon" another Shadow Court Satyr. Is that possible?

The Summoning
[FN:C2, LotN:PS, KoT:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Presence
+1 stealth action.
Search your library for an ally or retainer. Show it to all players and put it in your hand (shuffle and discard afterward).
Search your library for an ally. This vampire recruits that ally (requirements and cost apply as normal). Shuffle afterward.

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Heys again!
>
> Please assure me that with The Summoning i can play an ally i've just played with the same minion!
>
That is correct. The first action is to recruit a Shadow Court Satyr, the second action is a The Summoning action (which is a recruit action if you recruit an ally).

NRA limits you to one "recruit SCS" action, one "The Summoning" action, but you can do both in a single turn.
